name: Extra Seconds
description: A little longer at the cutting board.

name: Faster Throwing
description: A steady hand at the produce basket.

name: Better Prices
description: Your slices are becoming rather sought after.

name: Sharp Edge
description: A considered improvement to a questionable blade.

name: Double Toss
description: One hand was never enough for this institution.

name: Combo Cash
description: Reward the rhythm of a well-kept kitchen.
effect: +5% per combo step per level (up to 10 steps)

name: Extra Cuts
description: Make more of every carefully cultivated tomato.
effect: +1 rewarded cut per tomato per level (up to 7). Swipe again to cut the pieces.

name: Combo Window
description: A little room between the movements.
effect: +0.15 seconds of combo grace per level

name: Overtime
description: A productive kitchen earns a little more time.
effect: Every 10 rewarded cuts: +0.5s per level. Up to 4 bonuses, with a 60-second round ceiling.

name: Cherry · Variety Unlock
description: A small, spirited specimen. Unlocks automatic Cherry harvests.
effect: Adds Cherry to the calculated harvest: $3 base value, small and fast.

name: Cherry · Harvest Frequency
description: Cultivate a greater share of this energetic variety.
effect: +50% relative Cherry spawn weight per level. Percentages are calculated automatically.

name: Cherry · Premium Quality
description: Better-grown fruit commands a better price.
effect: +25% Cherry cut value per level. Applies to its separated pieces too.

name: Cherry · Harvest Dominance
description: A fine harvest gradually replaces less profitable lower tiers.
effect: Reduces lower-tier weight by 10% per level, reaching zero at level 10.
